subject.title: [Bug]: sessions_yield subagent wake can compact parent branch at low context usage

question: Should OpenClaw add persisted compaction trigger metadata and require per-call/contextUsage-backed overflow decisions for `sessions_yield` parent-wake compaction when provider context snapshots are absent?
rationale: The remaining work crosses runtime usage attribution, overflow policy, and persisted transcript schema, so automation should not choose the permanent compaction contract alone.

options.title: Add attribution and snapshot-backed policy
options.body: Persist a closed trigger reason on compaction entries and make parent-wake overflow decisions rely on contextUsage or last-call snapshots with live subagent-yield proof.

options.title: Keep current fallback and request repro
options.body: Treat PR #99864 as enough for now and wait for a new current-main reproduction before changing persisted compaction schema.

options.title: Scope to attribution only
options.body: Add compaction trigger metadata first while leaving overflow fallback semantics unchanged until more provider data is available.

recommendation.title: Add attribution and snapshot-backed policy
recommendation.body: Persist a closed trigger reason on compaction entries and make parent-wake overflow decisions rely on contextUsage or last-call snapshots with live subagent-yield proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He landed the latest adjacent compaction repair and is the best routed owner for deciding whether the remaining schema/policy change should ship.
